note: RECOMMENDED config. This is deliberately NOT the raw grid-search argmax (which picked gateThreshold=0.52, evidence_thresh=0.25, rim_fraction=0.13 by fitting in-sample on both labeled courses combined). Leave-one-course-out cross-validation showed that the grid search's greedy 'max passes at zero-false-accept-on-train' objective does not reliably preserve zero false accepts out of sample: a threshold picked from GoldenTeeSet alone (0.47) produced a false accept on AlexClarkSet hole 18 (NCC 0.518, 145.3px off) that the current shipped default (0.55) avoids. See grayt-tuning-report.md for the full LOOCV table and reasoning. This file instead recommends the ONE change that held up as a safe, non-overfit improvement: widening the stage-1 closing window from 18px to 24px (both LOOCV folds independently preferred it, and applying it -- alone, at the UNCHANGED default gate threshold -- is a Pareto improvement on both labeled courses: AlexClarkSet gate-passes 7/18 -> 8/18 with zero false accepts maintained on both courses, GoldenTeeSet essentially unchanged). The gate threshold and all stage-2 geometry are left at their current shipped defaults; lowering the gate below 0.55 is NOT recommended based on the evidence gathered here.

evaluatedOnBothLabeledCourses.note: In-sample (both courses' truth is visible to this single-parameter check) but low-risk: the only change is closing_window_px, and it improves or matches both courses simultaneously without touching the gate. Not a substitute for the LOOCV numbers in grayt-tuning-report.md.

rawGridSearchArgmax.note: The literal grid-search winner (in-sample fit on both courses combined) -- kept here for reference, NOT recommended, see note above.
